sentences.text:
W.P.No.21206 of 2018
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 W.P.No.21206 of 2018
Order:

This writ petition is filed to direct the respondents not to widen the road from Saibaba Temple to Durga Mata Temple in Vempati Village, Tungturthi Mandal, Suryapet District by taking the land of the petitioner in Sy.No.691/1/5/1 situated at Vempati Village, Tungaturthi Mandal, Suryapet District without acquiring his land and paying compensation to the petitioner.

2. This Court, while admitting the writ petition on 25.06.2018, granted interim order directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession and enjoyment of the petitioner over his land admeasuring Ac.3.00 gts in Sy.No.691/1/5/1 of Vempati Village, Tungaturthi Mandal, Suryapet District.
However, in spite of lapse of more than 7 years, the respondents did not choose to file counter or vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioners.
In view of the same, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject property without following due process of law.

However, if the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they shall follow due procedure under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
